name: meep-bird-desktop
description: Take a Meep: a real-footage American woodcock desktop timer companion for macOS.

scripts.package:mac: electron-packager . "Take a Meep" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --prune=true --asar --app-bundle-id=com.meepbird.desktop --app-version=0.8.1 --ignore="^/(VideoFrames|tools|test|artifacts|assets/source|assets/character/(call|call-v2|call-v2-clean|walk|walk-v2|puppet-v2|puppet-v3))" && cp assets/icon/MeepBird.icns "dist/Take a Meep-darwin-arm64/Take a Meep.app/Contents/Resources/electron.icns" && codesign --force --deep --sign - "dist/Take a Meep-darwin-arm64/Take a Meep.app"
